title: Nanao's Sea Urchin: A Culinary Treasure from Shenzhen's Coastline
description: Discover Nanao's prized purple sea urchins! Yongshi Chen explores their unique habitat, traditional harvesting at sunset, and meticulous processing from spiky shells to golden roe. Learn how locals craft sashimi, fried rice, and dumplings with this delicacy. Dive into Shenzhen’s coastal culture and savor the journey from ocean to plate!
